meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 把实现工作放进独立的 git worktree 里跑完整 PR 流程：按 ulw-loop 实现、做有证据的人工 QA、写英文 PR、循环过 CI 和 Cubic 检查，默认自动合并后清理 worktree。大任务会拆成多个可独立合并的小 PR，并行开工。
howto.when: 当实现工作要以 PR 形式落地时触发，比如你说“create a PR”“implement and PR”“split into atomic PRs”等，或语境暗示要交付 PR 时说“implement X”。

say.text: 把这个任务拆成几个能独立合并的小 PR，然后并行实现
say.note: 它会先拆分，再各开一个 worktree 并行推进

say.text: 实现这个 issue 并开 PR，走完整验证流程
say.note: 实现、QA、建 PR，再过 CI 与 Cubic 直到合并

say.text: PR 的 CI 挂了，回到 worktree 修好并重新做人工 QA
say.note: 修复后重新入循环，从 CI 重新验证

howto.what_en: Runs the full PR lifecycle in an isolated task-owned git worktree: implements via ulw-loop with evidence-bound manual QA, writes an English PR, loops on CI and Cubic gates, and auto-merges by default then cleans up. Large tasks split into small independently-mergeable PRs built in parallel.
howto.when_en: Triggers when implementation work must land as a PR: say "create a PR", "implement and PR", "split into atomic PRs" and similar, or just "implement X" when the context implies PR delivery.

say_en.text: Split this task into small independently-mergeable PRs and implement them in parallel
say_en.note: It splits first, then runs one worktree per PR

say_en.text: Implement this issue and open a PR, running the full verification flow
say_en.note: Implement, QA, open PR, then loop CI and Cubic until merged

say_en.text: CI failed on the PR; go back to the worktree, fix it and redo manual QA
say_en.note: Fixes re-enter the loop from the CI gate
